subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default picker display policy, or by folding it into broader runtime/auth-route picker work?
rationale: The request adds new config surface, current Control UI and TUI behavior differ, and adjacent open picker work already explores runtime/auth-route visibility.

options.title: Pick a canonical display policy first
options.body: Decide the default/hybrid picker display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if a per-user preference is still needed.

options.title: Add the requested opt-in config
options.body: Accept the extra config surface and require one documented schema path that applies consistently to Control UI and TUI.

options.title: Fold into picker observability work
options.body: Route this through the runtime/auth-route picker cluster to avoid parallel label schemes and competing model-picker settings.

recommendation.title: Pick a canonical display policy first
recommendation.body: Decide the default/hybrid picker display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if a per-user preference is still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership touches the moved Control UI/TUI/config surfaces involved in this decision.
